ideas.title: The Web of Deceit: Uncovering Minnesota's Medicaid Fraud Network
ideas.description: Investigate the network of individuals and organizations involved in the $90 million Medicaid fraud scheme in Minnesota.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and identify key players
ideas.insight: This story would uncover the intricate web of deceit and corruption within Minnesota's Medicaid program, highlighting the need for greater oversight and accountability.

ideas.title: The Feeding Our Future Scandal: A Deeper Dive
ideas.description: Investigate the $250 million Feeding Our Future fraud case, including the mastermind behind the scheme and the impact on Minnesota's nonprofit sector.
questions: What are the implications for Minnesota's nonprofit sector?
ideas.insight: This story would provide a deeper understanding of the Feeding Our Future scandal, highlighting the need for greater transparency and accountability in Minnesota's nonprofit sector.
